script.cover_1: The senior leaders clap. Whose name did they hear?
script.cover_2: Here is how credit goes right.
script.payoff: A good manager names the person who built it and lets them speak.
script.caption: Credit costs a manager one sentence and a junior a whole year. Send this to someone whose work was presented by another name.
script.request: A manager presents the team's work to senior leaders.
script.pushy: I handled the heavy work, the team supported.
script.professional: The newest member of our team built this part. They can explain it best.
script.why: It names who did the work and hands them the stage.
script.reply_me: Could I present my part to the leaders next time? I know the details best.
